scope: Warm-up development search; five globally fixed policies, fresh original proofs and private per-cell caches. No overall wall cap and no model calls. Finite work bounds and existing individual Lean/discovery watchdogs apply. Scores use canonical denominators. No held-out or global-optimality claim. Explicit recovery: completed source cells are retained unchanged; failed or missing cells rerun from original proofs under the pinned repaired runtime. Aggregate timings combine source and recovery runs.
